note: HAND-MAINTAINED, unlike runs/spent_windows.json which is derived from holdout_access records. It records DISCOVERY windows, including historical analyses that bypassed research.experiment_log. New studies use discovery_trial records, which the holdout ledger does not aggregate. Add a row when an analysis selects on a window; cite its .planning document.
why_this_file_exists: CLAUDE.md's Discovery/Confirmation split says a designated discovery window is deliberately and permanently spent. Only confirmation spends were recorded anywhere, so a discovery-spent window read as available -- the same class of stale claim that once called KRX daily unspent the day after it was spent.
known_gap: Historical rd-* Korean analyses were not logged and this hand-maintained ledger can still go stale. research.experiment_log.run_discovery_trial now supports studies without folds and durably records starts before evaluation (rd-ab). New studies must adopt it; this does not reconstruct old trials or automatically retrofit old scripts.
